Pricing and key dates

The $110 reservation fee secures a place in line. A separate $3,000 device deposit is scheduled for summer 2027. The $11,000 device price excludes taxes and shipping.

Delivery and warranty

Delivery regions include North America, Europe, the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand. includes a two-year limited warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, with service from Lux Vitae Industries in Los Angeles.
